EXP-MAP-A03-prereg-v1 conditional rank-permutation fixed-graph null. Sort 37,936 accepted rows by (conductor, ASCII label); assign 10 strata s=floor(10*i/n), i zero-based. Hold identities, conductor, exact arithmetic status, MCJ coordinates, k=10 graph, and within-stratum rank multisets fixed. Exactly B=999 draws use one continuing SplitMix64 stream seeded 4103; 64-bit increment 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15, multipliers 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9 and 0x94D049BB133111EB, modulo 2^64; randbelow rejects values at/above floor(2^64/m)*m then returns modulo m; Fisher-Yates runs i=m-1..1 with j=randbelow(i+1). Per draw process strata 0..9, independently permuting original observed ranks within each stratum; never reset stream, cumulatively permute, skip, reroll, or regenerate. T=-mean_edges(|rank_i-rank_j|); p=(1+count(T_b>=T_obs))/1000; one-sided greater; alpha=0.005; reject iff p<0.005.
